basic_profile.bio: A 26-year-old graphic designer from Portland, Oregon. I recently got into gaming during the pandemic and fell in love with Stardew Valley. I'm still figuring out all the mechanics but enjoy the relaxed pace. I dislike overly competitive games and prefer those that allow creativity. I'm usually online in the evenings after work and spend weekends exploring new web design techniques. Single, and enjoy taking my dog on hikes around the Pacific Northwest.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for about 4 years. Most of my knowledge in gaming comes from online forums and YouTube tutorials. I also dabble in web development, particularly with platforms like Wix, to better understand the user experience side of design.
